records.text: Owens said a trusted unnamed source described Kirk’s message to Dan Flood as an iMessage saying they were going to kill him, rather than a Telegram message specifying the left.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I was the one who revealed, and I did not say the left because I was told it did not say the left. ... I was told that he said they are going to kill me to Dan Flood. And I have it on good authority also that the message went out to Dan Flood via iMessage, not Telegram, to strike you again as remarkably. ... What I didn't reveal to Erika (Erika Kirk) is that a source that I trust deeply, much more than I trust Erika (Erika Kirk), and who has been more consistent on telling the truth about what happened on that day, said the text messages were received on iMessage. ... So I am not inclined to believe that these messages are on Telegram.
